gate.reason: All required checks need exact current passing-case links, resolved mappings and actual execution coverage; static source matches do not close feature acceptance.

checkTemplates.page-states: Exercise this page's actual loading, empty, error/retry and successful states, including navigation and reload.
checkTemplates.page-access: Verify the page's declared public/authenticated/admin access policy and cross-user resource boundary.
checkTemplates.page-persistence: Submit applicable page actions, verify the corresponding backend result, and reload to confirm durable state; verify failed writes do not show success.
checkTemplates.control-behavior: Operate this exact control with real user events; assert the visible result and the intended handler/API request, including disabled and invalid-input behavior.
checkTemplates.control-failure: Force the control's request/dependency to fail or time out; verify error/retry/cancel behavior and that no unconfirmed success or duplicate mutation is shown.
checkTemplates.response-contract: Call the exact registered method/path and assert status, content type and response schema for successful, empty and nonexistent-resource cases as applicable.
checkTemplates.access-policy: Establish and test this endpoint's declared anonymous/authenticated/admin policy; reject unauthorized requests without leaking protected data.
checkTemplates.input-boundaries: Test actual path/query/body boundaries and malformed or excessive input; assert validation occurs before side effects. Record explicit non-applicability for absent inputs.
checkTemplates.tenant-boundary: For scoped resources, use distinct fixture identities to prove ownership/tenant isolation on both reads and writes.
checkTemplates.dependency-failure: Make each required database/storage/provider dependency fail or time out; assert an honest bounded failure and preserve retryable state.
checkTemplates.mutation-durability: Verify the real mutation with durable readback/reopen, transaction rollback on failure, idempotent retries and concurrent delivery where applicable.
checkTemplates.deletion-durability: Verify ownership, durable removal and retained/reference cleanup; repeated deletes and interrupted cleanup must not resurrect or erase another user's data.
checkTemplates.callback-integrity: Verify applicable provider signature/state/nonce, replay and duplicate-event handling against the actual callback handler and stored state.
checkTemplates.readiness-truth: Prove required child/dependency capability before ready=200; unloaded/unavailable capability must remain unavailable and recover only after actual readiness.
checkTemplates.artifact-integrity: Validate the delivered artifact's declared format, decode/content constraints, ownership, durable bytes and retry/delivery receipt; distinguish procedural output from learned quality.
checkTemplates.dns-wire-contract: Exercise actual DNS question/type/record handling, response RCODE/flags/TTL and serialized wire bytes; assert malformed-packet and unsupported-query behavior.

fixtureTemplates.browser-control: Use real Chromium events and the actual component. Supply controlled read/error data and verify actual requests, cancellation and visible states. Add the tracked node:test file; the canonical Node runner discovers it automatically.
fixtureTemplates.browser-page: Use the real page in an isolated app/browser fixture with separate users. Verify every applicable action and persisted outcome; a page render alone does not close business checks.
fixtureTemplates.main-http: Add the suggested file to vitest.integration.config.ts test.include. The isolated wrapper supplies disposable SQL/app and TEST_BASE_URL; never hardcode the developer port or database.
fixtureTemplates.python-loopback-router: Exercise the actual imported Python handler/router in a disposable fixture on an ephemeral loopback port, with generated local-channel auth where required. Do not import the unbounded full server, use live fixed ports, or fabricate model readiness/quality.
fixtureTemplates.imported-api-loopback: Use the actual imported Express router and disposable PostgreSQL/fabric. Follow run-pdim-smoke.mjs isolation and egress guards; do not start corpus download schedulers or aim mutations at a deployed service.
fixtureTemplates.native-rust: Use Cargo integration tests and temporary state. Start the verified sidecar on an ephemeral port when HTTP behavior is required; assert real durable/error behavior and stop only owned processes.
fixtureTemplates.native-go: Run the Go package's tests with in-memory DNS messages and temporary/listening fixture state as applicable. Assert wire response/security/error behavior; external authoritative DNS is a separate deployment check.

evidenceLinking.conjunctiveCaseBundles: An explicit cases array requires every unique exact case to pass with the current test hash and shared platformSourceDigest; no partial bundle closes a check.
evidenceLinking.meaning: Links bind automated passing case evidence to named requirements; absent links mean unverified behavior, not a request for human approval.

limits: Source declarations and import reachability do not prove that code executed or that business assertions cover it.
The endpoint audit resolves main-server topology; imported declarations with unproven mounts retain that uncertainty.
JSX controls/event bindings are indexed; runtime-generated controls, DOM mutation and data-dependent interactions still need explicit behavioral cases.
An unreferenced component or unresolved mount may be retained/retired source rather than an active feature. Prove its runtime admission or exclusion before treating it as a current production gap.
Route/UI requirements are a minimum test plan; domain-specific financial, legal, media-quality and provider semantics need their own assertions.
V8 coverage covers instrumented JavaScript/TypeScript only; Python, Go and Rust remain separate test/evidence scopes.
No production readiness, provider delivery, model quality, native VST3 processing or Replit deployment is inferred from this register.
